# pve_container (Resource)

Manages one LXC container, either from an `ostemplate` or by cloning an existing container via the create-only `clone` block. The resource models the pinned subset of the container config: PVE configuration keys it does not model (for example `netN`, `features`, `devN`, `startup`, `tty`) are never sent and never removed. Import ID is `<node>/<vmid>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# LXC container created from an OS template on local storage.
resource "pve_container" "ct1" {
  vmid         = 100
  node         = "pve1"
  ostemplate   = "local:vztmpl/debian-12-standard_12.7-1_amd64.tar.zst"
  hostname     = "ct1"
  unprivileged = true
  cores        = 2
  memory       = 512

  mount_points = [
    {
      id      = "rootfs"
      storage = "local-lvm"
      size    = "8G"
    },
    {
      id         = "mp0"
      mountpoint = "/data"
      storage    = "local-lvm"
      size       = "4G"
      backup     = true
    },
  ]
}

# LXC container cloned from an existing container (create-only clone block).
resource "pve_container" "ct2" {
  vmid = 101
  node = "pve1"

  clone = {
    source_vmid = 100
    hostname    = "ct2"
    full        = true
    storage     = "local-lvm"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node the container runs on. Changing the node migrates the container via `POST .../migrate` (task-waiting) instead of recreating it.

### Optional

- `clone` (Attributes) Create the container by cloning an existing container instead of restoring an `ostemplate`. Mutually exclusive with `ostemplate`; changing the block forces replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clone))
- `cores` (Number) The number of cores assigned to the container. Must be between 1 and 8192.
- `description` (String) Description for the container; saved as comment inside the configuration file.
- `hostname` (String) Set a host name for the container.
- `memory` (Number) Amount of RAM for the container in MB. Must be at least 16.
- `mount_points` (Attributes List) Ordered mount points including the root volume. `rootfs` must appear at most once; `mp0`..`mp255` follow. Updating re-renders changed entries via `PUT .../config` and applies size growth through the resize verb. Bind mounts (a `volume` host path without `storage`) cannot be resized. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mount_points))
- `nameserver` (String) Sets DNS server IP addresses for the container. Create automatically uses the setting from the host if neither `nameserver` nor `searchdomain` is set.
- `onboot` (Boolean) Specifies whether the container will be started during system bootup.
- `ostemplate` (String) The OS template or backup file the container is created from (a volume string such as `local:vztmpl/debian-12-standard_12.7-1_amd64.tar.zst`). Create-only: exactly one of `ostemplate` or `clone` must be set; it is never sent on update.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Sets the root password inside the container at create time. PVE never returns it; the value is write-only after create.
- `protection` (Boolean) Sets the protection flag of the container. This prevents the container or its disks from removal or update operations.
- `searchdomain` (String) Sets DNS search domains for the container. Create automatically uses the setting from the host if neither `nameserver` nor `searchdomain` is set.
- `ssh_public_keys` (String, Sensitive) Setup public SSH keys (one key per line, OpenSSH format) at create time. PVE never returns it; the value is write-only after create.
- `started` (Boolean) Whether the container is started after creation (default `true`) and kept running. Toggling it starts or cleanly shuts the container down.
- `stop_on_destroy` (Boolean) Gracefully shut the container down (60s timeout, falling back to an abrupt stop) before destroying it. Defaults to `false`.
- `swap` (Number) Amount of SWAP for the container in MB. Must be at least 0.
- `tags` (String) Tags of the container (a `;`-separated list). This is only meta information.
- `template` (Boolean) Enable/disable the container template flag. Changing it forces replacement.
- `unprivileged` (Boolean) Makes the container run as an unprivileged user (creation default upstream is `true`). The pin marks this as should-not-be-modified-manually, so changing it forces replacement.
- `vmid` (Number) Container ID (100 - 999999999). When omitted at create time the next free ID is allocated via `GET /cluster/nextid`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the form `<node>/<vmid>`.
- `interfaces` (Attributes List) Network interfaces with discovered IP addresses from `GET .../interfaces`; null when the container is stopped (the endpoint requires a running container). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `pending_changes` (List of String) Configuration keys with a pending (not yet applied) value or a pending delete, from `GET .../pending`.
- `status` (String) Container status as reported by `GET .../status/current`: `stopped` or `running`.

<a id="nestedatt--clone"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clone`

Required:

- `source_vmid` (Number) VMID of the container to clone (100 - 999999999).

Optional:

- `full` (Boolean) Create a full copy of all disks. For container templates a linked clone is attempted by default when unset.
- `hostname` (String) Host name for the new container. Conflicts with setting `hostname` on the resource.
- `pool` (String) Add the new container to the specified pool.
- `storage` (String) Target storage for a full clone.


<a id="nestedatt--mount_points"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mount_points`

Required:

- `id` (String) Mount point config key: `rootfs` or `mp0`..`mp255`.

Optional:

- `acl` (Boolean) Explicitly enable or disable ACL support.
- `backup` (Boolean) Whether to include the mount point in backups (only used for volume mount points).
- `mountpoint` (String) Path inside the container where the volume is mounted. Required for `mpN` entries; must be empty for `rootfs` (the pin defines no `mp=` option there).
- `ro` (Boolean) Read-only mount point.
- `size` (String) Volume size in PVE disk-size notation (for example `8G`). Growth-only: shrinking is rejected and the growth is applied via the resize verb. Required when allocating a new volume from `storage`.
- `storage` (String) Storage holding the volume. Set together with `size` to allocate a new volume, or with `volume` to reference an existing one. Leave unset for bind mounts given via `volume`.
- `volume` (String) Existing volume id or host path (bind mount). Takes precedence over storage allocation when `storage` is unset.


<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `hwaddr` (String) Interface MAC address.
- `inet` (String) IPv4 address with prefix length, when assigned.
- `inet6` (String) IPv6 address with prefix length, when assigned.
- `name` (String) Interface name as seen inside the container.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

terraform import pve_container.ct1 pve1/100
```
